acs.text_first_line: AC1 A settlement whose accounts match is decided BOOKED and recorded once
AC2 A missing booking is decided NO_BOOKING only after the grace batches, and the grace is a parameter
AC3 A booked term that differs is decided TERMS_DIFFER with the terms on the record
AC4 Only some accounts of the case are booked
AC5 No decision is taken for a business date whose batch is not complete
AC6 No version in force is a refusal, never a default
AC7 A repeat or a rerun writes no second record and publishes no second event
AC8 The record is written before the decision leaves, so a failed record stops the decision
AC9 The read serves the decisions of a date and no personal data leaves
